description: ADO-CURSOR defaults from the Connection: Connection.CursorLocation = client before Open; a Recordset with no CursorLocation set reads its CursorLocation before Open, then opens a forward-only read-only request on T (State, effective CursorType, LockType, CursorLocation, RecordCount, Supports adBookmark); a second Recordset sets server explicitly first; Connection.CursorLocation is then set to server and a third Recordset opens; a keyset request on the client Connection; a Connection.Execute result and a Command.Execute result on each setting. Asks how a Recordset takes its location and what the effective tuple is in each case.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
